title: Garmin announces third quarter 2026 results
summary: Schaffhausen, Switzerland/October 28, 2026/PR Newswire – Garmin® Ltd. (NYSE: GRMN), today announced results for the third quarter ended September 26, 2026. Highlights include: View the PDF for the full press release and financial results.

**About Garmin International, Inc.**


Garmin International Inc. is a subsidiary of Garmin Ltd. (NYSE: GRMN). Garmin Ltd. is incorporated in Switzerland, and its principal subsidiaries are located in the United States, Taiwan and the United Kingdom. Garmin is a registered trademark.
